name: @withmarfa/integration-sync
description: Local-runtime integration for the sync agent. Defines the manifest the agent installs against; the actual execution is the daemon in the withmarfa/sync repo (npm: @withmarfa/sync). The companion server-side migration at packages/server/src/scripts/deprecated/migrate-sync-json-to-connection.ts re-presents an existing ~/.marfa/sync.json as a Connection + Credential pair.
